pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal shapes with sharp, high-contrast pixel gradients at the edges. Relative spatial area is large on the flank, with geometry shifting to smaller, more fragmented trapezoidal shapes on the lower neck.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous cream-colored pathways forming a connected graph. Junction nodes are primarily tri-valent (Y-junctions). Pixel thickness of these paths is relatively constant across the flank but decreases in width towards the shoulder and neck.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: A low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated profile along the dorsal neck, appearing as a dark, textured 1D contour against the lighter background.

other_distinctive_markers: A distinct dark avian silhouette is perched on the lateral-dorsal transition of the lower neck and shoulder region.
